facts.fact: Parma lies in northern Emilia-Romagna along the Via Emilia.
facts.excerpt: The city is located in the Northern part of the region Emilia-Romagna, along the Via Emilia

facts.fact: The regional guide identifies art, music, green spaces and gastronomy as complementary city interests.
facts.excerpt: Parma’s center is full of art masterpieces, wide green spaces, little and big treasures from different ages

facts.fact: Parma was designated UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy in2015.
facts.excerpt: In 2015, Parma was designated as a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy.

facts.fact: PiazzaDuomo contains the Cathedral of the Assumption and Baptistery.
facts.excerpt: Piazza Duomo, where the highest artistic and religious expressions of the city stand

facts.fact: The cathedral is a Romanesque building, started around1059 and consecrated1106.
facts.excerpt: dedicated to the Assumption, which is among the main representative Romanesque buildings of the Padana region, started around the year 1059 and consecrated in 1106

facts.fact: The Baptistery uses pink Verona marble and represents the transition from lateRomanesque toGothic.
facts.excerpt: a symbol of the passage from the late Romanesque to Gothic era, made of pink marble from Verona

facts.fact: Pilotta was a Farnese court and state-service palace.
facts.excerpt: an ancient palace of the court and state services belonging to the Farnese family.

facts.fact: Pilotta houses ArchaeologicalMuseum,PalatinaLibrary,NationalGallery,FarneseTheatre,BodoniMuseum; the guide does not promise all rooms open.
facts.excerpt: The rooms host the Archaeological Museum, Petitot gallery of Palatina Library, the National Gallery, the Farnese Theatre and the Bodoni Museum.

facts.fact: DucalPark provides a green walking setting with established trees and sculpture.
facts.excerpt: Ducal park is the right place, a beautiful green area with secular trees and sculptural groups.

facts.fact: Parma food includes ProsciuttoDiParma,ParmigianoReggiano and stuffed pasta; no restaurant endorsements inferred.
facts.excerpt: Prosciutto di Parma PDO is made, but also Parmigiano Reggiano cheese PDO
